# Resourcing and economics joined to the recommendation register

**UIOWA-105.** Generated by `integrate.py`. Deterministic; no clock, no RNG.

> Every figure below originates in a synthetic fixture or in a synthetic component output. None of it is a University of Iowa finding.

## The two views disagree on purpose

Shared work appears under every recommendation that needs it in the per-recommendation view, and exactly once in the portfolio roll-up. The difference is published below as shared_work_not_double_counted.

Five ledgers are reported separately and are never summed across: hours (one-time implementation); FTE-fraction per year (recurring staff load); currency (one-time); currency per year (recurring); staff-hours released per year (recurring). Adding across any two raises LedgerUnitError.

Currency for all cash ledgers: **USD** (declared by the economics component; this lane does not convert or infer it).

|---|---|---|---|
| hours (one-time implementation) | 282.00 - 471.00 - 772.00 *(floor)* | 397.00 - 661.00 - 1062.00 *(floor)* | 115.00 - 190.00 - 290.00 |
| FTE-fraction per year (recurring staff load) | 0.11 - 0.20 - 0.40 *(floor)* | 0.14 - 0.27 - 0.52 *(floor)* | 0.03 - 0.06 - 0.12 |
| currency (one-time) | 2400.00 - 3800.00 - 6000.00 *(floor)* | 4800.00 - 7600.00 - 12000.00 *(floor)* | 2400.00 - 3800.00 - 6000.00 |
| currency per year (recurring) | 900.00 - 1400.00 - 2200.00 *(floor)* | 1800.00 - 2800.00 - 4400.00 *(floor)* | 900.00 - 1400.00 - 2200.00 |
| staff-hours released per year (recurring) | 186.40 - 363.00 - 617.95 *(floor)* | 326.40 - 623.00 - 1067.95 *(floor)* | 140.00 - 260.00 - 450.00 |

A *(floor)* marker means at least one contributor supplied no estimate. Those contributors are named in the JSON and are **not** counted as zero.

### Work shared by more than one recommendation

- `WI-PLATFORM-CI-001` Extend the shared CI status-check configuration — needed by `REC-SYN-ESS-SD-001`, `REC-SYN-IAM-SD-001`. Counted once in the roll-up, shown under each recommendation.
- `WI-TRAIN-ACCESSREV-001` Access-review training for application owners — needed by `REC-SYN-IAM-SEC-001`, `REC-SYN-RIS-SEC-001`. Counted once in the roll-up, shown under each recommendation.
